title: Hermes per project under the agent profile, shared login and skill library, no work budgets
user_story: As the researcher I get one Hermes per project that keeps its own memory, signs in to Nous once for all projects, can use skills I approved for sharing, and works as long as it needs.

requirements.description: Workspace mode follows tools.client_profiles.hermes (workspace_write gives a writable workspace); Hermes always gets phdlab_tools_search/describe/call.

Runtime mounts the app-wide hermes-shared/auth (HERMES_SHARED_AUTH_DIR) and hermes-shared/skills read-only (skills.external_dirs in a newly created project config; an existing config is never rewritten); share_skill copies one reviewed skill and records the approver.

Jobs carry no deadline/iteration/token limit unless the owner sets one; the service passes none to AIAgent (its defaults are unlimited) and the supervisor waits without a deadline; observation has no deadline but fails when the runtime is unreachable for 120 s.
Starting the open project stops (never removes) other projects Hermes containers; the unused proxy domain allowlist variable is removed.

nonfunctional: No host source, Docker socket or PhD credentials mounted
dependencies: nousresearch/hermes-agent@sha256:9c5561579f3f (HERMES_SHARED_AUTH_DIR and skills.external_dirs verified in the image)
acceptance_criteria: Real container READY with the expected mounts
Hermes resolves the shared skill directory

scenarios.expected: assisted by default, review without workspace_write
Shared mounts, other project paused, config linked
Other project containers stopped, own kept, proxy env removed
List and share through the API
Long job and transient RPC errors survive
Service admits budget-free jobs; AIAgent gets defaults

recovery: Set hermes deadline_s/max_iterations/max_tokens above 0 for an owner limit; narrow tools.client_profiles.hermes; revert hermes.py/service.py and rebuild the adapter image. TASK-HERMES-NATIVE-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Docker/vendor MOCKED in unit tests; additional REAL_LOCAL_DOCKER smoke (start/health/mounts/stop, shared skill discovery) in live-docker-smoke.json; no Nous sign-in or inference.

review.method: Same-agent review (not independent); upstream API facts checked inside the pinned image (AIAgent defaults, shared auth dir, external_dirs).

tdd.scope: RED: 9 FAIL/ERROR before implementation. GREEN: 10/10 PASS (API scenario added during implementation).
